en.headline: Police investigate death of officer found with gunshot wound at Sheung Shui station
en.dek: A male officer from the New Territories North traffic unit was confirmed dead at the scene after a report at about 10:50am on Thursday.
body: Police are investigating the death of a male officer who was found with a gunshot wound inside Sheung Shui Police Station on Thursday morning.

A police spokesman said the officer was confirmed dead at the scene after the case was reported at about 10:50am. The officer, believed to be attached to the New Territories North traffic unit, was found in a men’s toilet at the station, according to sources.
Authorities are treating the case as a suspected suicide and are conducting further inquiries. No other details about the circumstances have been released.

zh.headline: 上水警署男警疑自轟身亡 警方正調查
zh.dek: 一名新界北交通部男警今早約10時50分被發現於警署內有槍傷，當場證實死亡，警方循自殺方向調查。
body: 警方正調查一名男警於周四早上在上水警署內被發現有槍傷並當場死亡的事件。
警方發言人表示，今早約10時50分接報後，該名男警已證實於現場死亡。消息稱涉事男警隸屬新界北交通部，在警署男廁內被發現。
警方正循自殺方向調查事件，並進行進一步查詢。目前未有公布更多細節。
